system_name.description: Identifier for this configuration set; must be a valid Lisp symbol.

system_description.description: Human-readable description of the configuration system.

version.description: Version string for the configuration, used for tracking.

package_sources.description: List of source repositories or local paths from which to install packages.

type.description: Source type: Git repo, local directory, or Quicklisp registry.

path.description: URL or filesystem path of the source. Required for `git` and `local`.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commitish) — used only for `git` sources.

commit.description: Specific Git commit hash to pin — overrides `ref` if provided.

submodules.description: Whether to initialize/update Git submodules when cloning.

description.description: Optional human-readable note about this source.

packages.description: List of Quicklisp or system packages to install and configure.

name.description: Name of the package (as known to Quicklisp or ASDF). Required.

source.description: Name of the source (from `package_sources`) to use for this package.

dependencies.description: List of package names this package depends on.

post-install.description: Lisp code to run after installation (e.g., `(ql:quickload :my-package)`).

description.description: Optional description of what this package provides.

operations.description: List of shell-like or Lisp commands to execute (e.g., directory setup, file generation).

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the operation does.

command.description: Lisp function or shell command to execute (e.g., `ensure-directories-exist`, `run`.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command (strings or quoted symbols).

hooks.description: System hooks to run on specific events (e.g., `:after-load`, `:post-config`).

code.description: Lisp expression (body) to evaluate when the hook fires.

description.description: Short explanation of the hook's purpose.
